extracted.intended_audience: students and researchers in zoology and comparative morphology (readers interested in crustacean anatomy)
extracted.subtask_description: A descriptive, comparative overview of crustacean external and internal anatomy, covering segmentation, appendage types, gills, alimentary, circulatory, excretory and nervous systems, and sensory organs. Intended as a reference or teaching text summarizing typical structures and variations across crustacean groups.
